t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to test out different coloured gnomes in the earlier rounds to see which ones provide the most mushrooms. If a gnome gives 0 mushrooms try to remember it. After the breaks do this again to understand which gnomes give better mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: Try each colour gnome at the beginning and if it gives a low value then move onto the next colour and try not to pick that one. Then once you can see a pattern of which gnomes give you the most mushrooms try to recite the colours in your head so you remember which ones are giving the most mushrooms currently. But don't be fooled, it will change up throughout the duration of the game so if you find a colour is giving less mushrooms before select the opposite colour and this should give you more mushrooms.
